title: Cambodian Data Catalogs Provenance and Maintenance Registry
description: Authoritative metadata, regulatory provenance, update procedures, and validation schemas for all 22 offline datasets.

datasets.title: Standard Digital Software Engineering UI Localization Dictionary
datasets.source_authority: Digital Economy and Telecommunication Localization Standards & Field Industry Practices
datasets.known_gaps: Focuses on high-frequency mobile and web UI; specialized medical or military jargon is out of scope.
datasets.update_procedure: Propose additions via pull request; must include en, km, category, and prohibited hallucination terms; tested via tests/test_ui_terms.py.
datasets.validation_rules: Unique keys, required fields [key, en, km, category, avoid], 0 royal register words.

datasets.title: Cambodia 25 Administrative Divisions (1 Capital + 24 Provinces)
datasets.source_authority: Ministry of Interior / National Committee for Sub-National Democratic Development (NCDD) & ISO 3166-2:KH
datasets.known_gaps: Provincial boundary GPS polygons are not included to preserve zero-dependency lightweight size.
datasets.update_procedure: Cross-reference official Royal Kram decrees on administrative adjustments with NCDD gazette.
datasets.validation_rules: Exact 25 entries; codes matching ISO 3166-2:KH (KH-1 to KH-25).

datasets.title: Phnom Penh Capital 14 Khans (Urban Districts)
datasets.source_authority: Phnom Penh Capital Hall Administration
datasets.known_gaps: Sub-commune (Sangkat) boundary adjustments require separate commune catalogs.
datasets.update_procedure: Verify against Phnom Penh Capital Hall sub-decrees.
datasets.validation_rules: Exact 14 Khans; code prefix 12xx; non-empty bilingual names.

datasets.title: Siem Reap Province Districts and Municipalities
datasets.source_authority: Siem Reap Provincial Administration / NCDD
datasets.known_gaps: Does not delineate APSARA heritage management zoning overlays.
datasets.update_procedure: Cross-reference provincial administration reports.
datasets.validation_rules: 12 entries; code prefix 17xx.

datasets.title: Battambang Province Districts and Municipalities
datasets.source_authority: Battambang Provincial Administration / NCDD
datasets.known_gaps: None identified for district-level administrative units.
datasets.update_procedure: Cross-reference with NCDD database updates.
datasets.validation_rules: 14 entries; code prefix 02xx.

datasets.title: Kandal Province Districts and Municipalities
datasets.source_authority: Kandal Provincial Administration / NCDD
datasets.known_gaps: Sub-decrees occasionally transfer border communes to Phnom Penh.
datasets.update_procedure: Check Ministry of Interior sub-decrees on municipal expansions.
datasets.validation_rules: 11 entries; code prefix 08xx.

datasets.title: Kampong Cham Province Districts and Municipalities
datasets.source_authority: Kampong Cham Provincial Administration / NCDD
datasets.known_gaps: Reflects post-2013 split separating Tboung Khmum province.
datasets.update_procedure: Verify against NCDD gazette.
datasets.validation_rules: 10 entries; code prefix 03xx.

datasets.title: Kampot Province Districts and Municipalities
datasets.source_authority: Kampot Provincial Administration / NCDD
datasets.known_gaps: Bokor municipality creation included.
datasets.update_procedure: Verify against sub-decree No. 38 on Krong Bokor establishment.
datasets.validation_rules: 9 entries; code prefix 07xx.

datasets.title: Preah Sihanouk Province Districts and Municipalities
datasets.source_authority: Preah Sihanouk Provincial Administration / NCDD
datasets.known_gaps: Includes Koh Rong municipal island division.
datasets.update_procedure: Verify against sub-decree No. 05 on Krong Koh Rong.
datasets.validation_rules: 5 entries; code prefix 18xx.

datasets.title: Cambodian Riel (KHR) Circulating Banknote Denominations
datasets.source_authority: National Bank of Cambodia (NBC)
datasets.known_gaps: Excludes historical collector-only commemorative issues not widely accepted in retail.
datasets.update_procedure: Monitor National Bank of Cambodia official announcements on currency issuances.
datasets.validation_rules: 11 entries; values between 100 and 100000; non-empty security motif descriptions.

datasets.title: Cambodian Mobile Telecommunication Network Operators & TRC Prefixes
datasets.source_authority: Telecommunication Regulator of Cambodia (TRC)
datasets.known_gaps: Mobile Number Portability (MNP) means prefix does not guarantee current carrier network.
datasets.update_procedure: Inspect TRC National Numbering Plan publications; run tests/test_phone_normalization.py.
datasets.validation_rules: Operators must have valid MCC 456; TRC prefixes must be strings.

datasets.title: Cambodian National Statutory Public Holidays
datasets.source_authority: Ministry of Labour and Vocational Training (MLVT) & Royal Government Sub-Decree
datasets.known_gaps: Lunar-based holidays (Chhoung Krame, Pchum Ben) shift Gregorian dates annually per Royal Palace calendar.
datasets.update_procedure: Update annually in September/October when MLVT issues official holiday Prakas.
datasets.validation_rules: Entries must have bilingual titles, month/day specifications.

datasets.title: National Bank of Cambodia Bakong Participant Banks and MFIs
datasets.source_authority: National Bank of Cambodia (NBC) Bakong Switch
datasets.known_gaps: Lists prominent Tier-1 commercial banks; complete 60+ member list available on NBC registry.
datasets.update_procedure: Cross-reference with Bakong participant member directory.
datasets.validation_rules: Entries must have bank name, BIC/SWIFT code, and Bakong domain.

datasets.title: ISO 18245 Merchant Category Codes (MCC) for NBC Bakong KHQR Tag 52
datasets.source_authority: ISO 18245 & National Bank of Cambodia KHQR Specification
datasets.known_gaps: Captures standard merchant categories common in retail and hospitality.
datasets.update_procedure: Cross-reference ISO 18245 standard updates with NBC KHQR guidelines.
datasets.validation_rules: MCC must be 4 digits numeric string.

datasets.title: Cambodia Post Major Provincial & Border Postal Codes
datasets.source_authority: Ministry of Post and Telecommunications (MPTC) & Cambodia Post
datasets.known_gaps: Domestic e-commerce couriers do not route using postal codes; landmark routing is required.
datasets.update_procedure: Verify against MPTC 6-digit postal code registry.
datasets.validation_rules: Postal code must be 5 or 6 digits.

datasets.title: Cambodian Major Express Couriers and Delivery Services
datasets.source_authority: Ministry of Commerce (MoC) Business Registry & Carrier Publications
datasets.known_gaps: Covers primary domestic parcel networks; local motorcycle on-demand delivery apps expand dynamically.
datasets.update_procedure: Annual survey of active express logistics providers.
datasets.validation_rules: Entries must have company name, tracking URL pattern, and service scope.

datasets.title: Key Regulatory Ministries and Government Authorities
datasets.source_authority: Royal Government of Cambodia (RGC) Official Portal
datasets.known_gaps: Focuses on regulatory ministries relevant to tech, finance, labour, and commerce.
datasets.update_procedure: Review official RGC Cabinet restructuring decrees.
datasets.validation_rules: Valid acronym, official website, and bilingual titles.

datasets.title: Khmer Punctuation Marks and Typographical Signs
datasets.source_authority: The Unicode Consortium (Khmer U+1780..U+17FF & Khmer Symbols U+19E0..U+19FF)
datasets.known_gaps: None; reflects frozen Unicode standard.
datasets.update_procedure: Verify with new Unicode Consortium releases.
datasets.validation_rules: Codepoints must start with U+17 or U+19.

datasets.title: Standard NiDA / Khmer OS Keyboard Key Layout
datasets.source_authority: National Information Communications Technology Development Authority (NiDA)
datasets.known_gaps: Does not map Apple iOS default dynamic soft keyboard layouts.
datasets.update_procedure: Verify against NiDA keyboard specification standard.
datasets.validation_rules: Key records must define key, unshifted, and shifted characters.

datasets.title: Complete 33 Khmer Consonants with Vagga Phonology and Series
datasets.source_authority: Chuon Nath Khmer Dictionary / National Institute of Linguistics
datasets.known_gaps: None; comprehensive 33 consonant abugida catalog.
datasets.update_procedure: Permanent linguistic standard.
datasets.validation_rules: Exact 33 records; series 1 (A-series) or series 2 (O-series).

datasets.title: Standard Non-Deprecated Khmer Independent Vowels
datasets.source_authority: The Unicode Consortium & Chuon Nath Dictionary
datasets.known_gaps: Excludes archaic ligature forms deprecated in modern spelling.
datasets.update_procedure: Verify with Unicode Consortium updates.
datasets.validation_rules: Exact 14 records; codepoints in U+17A3..U+17B3.

datasets.title: Standard Khmer Noun Classifiers and Counting Word Standards
datasets.source_authority: National Institute of Linguistics & Standard Khmer Grammar
datasets.known_gaps: Focuses on high-frequency countable nouns in digital, commerce, and legal software.
datasets.update_procedure: Propose additions via pull request with examples and linguistic category.
datasets.validation_rules: Exact 16 records; fields [classifier_km, classifier_en, category, example_km].
